mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, creator_member_id, client_poll_key, request_hash, question, selection_mode, visibility, status, deadline_at, version, message_id, closed_by, closed_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into im_poll (conversation_id, creator_member_id, client_poll_key, request_hash, question, selection_mode, visibility, status, deadline_at, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{creatorMemberId}, #{clientPollKey}, #{requestHash}, #{question}, 'SINGLE', 'PUBLIC', 'OPEN', #{deadlineAt}, 1, now(3), now(3))
insert into im_poll_option (poll_id, position, content, create_time) values (#{pollId}, #{position}, #{content}, now(3))
mapper.select: select id, poll_id, position, content, 0 as vote_count from im_poll_option where poll_id = #{pollId} order by position

select o.id, o.poll_id, o.position, o.content, count(v.id) as vote_count from im_poll_option o left join im_poll_vote v on v.poll_id = o.poll_id and v.option_id = o.id where o.poll_id = #{pollId} group by o.id, o.poll_id, o.position, o.content order by o.position
mapper.update: update im_poll set message_id = #{messageId}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{pollId} and message_id is null and status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: insert into im_poll_audience (poll_id, member_id, create_time) select #{pollId}, cm.member_id, now(3) from im_conversation c join im_conversation_member cm on cm.conversation_id = c.id and cm.deleted = 0 where c.id = #{conversationId} and c.type = 4 and c.status = 0 and ( (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'team_' and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id and tm.member_id = cm.member_id and tm.status = 1 where c.biz_key = concat('team_', t.id) and t.status not in (3, 4) )) or (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'club_' and exists ( select 1 from club cl where c.biz_key = concat('club_', cl.id) and cl.status = 1 and cl.del_flag = 0 and (cl.member_id = cm.member_id or exists ( select 1 from club_member clm where clm.club_id = cl.id and clm.member_id = cm.member_id and clm.status = 1 and clm.del_flag = 0 )) )) )
mapper.select: select count(*) from im_poll_audience where poll_id = #{pollId} and member_id = #{memberId}
select option_id from im_poll_vote where poll_id = #{pollId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into im_poll_vote (poll_id, option_id, member_id, create_time) select p.id, o.id, #{memberId}, now(3) from im_poll p join im_poll_option o on o.poll_id = p.id and o.id = #{optionId} join im_conversation c on c.id = p.conversation_id and c.type = 4 and c.status = 0 join im_conversation_member cm on cm.conversation_id = c.id and cm.member_id = #{memberId} and cm.deleted = 0 where p.id = #{pollId} and p.status = 'OPEN' and (p.deadline_at is null or p.deadline_at > now(3)) and ( (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'team_' and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id and tm.member_id = #{memberId} and tm.status = 1 where c.biz_key = concat('team_', t.id) and t.status not in (3, 4) )) or (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'club_' and exists ( select 1 from club cl where c.biz_key = concat('club_', cl.id) and cl.status = 1 and cl.del_flag = 0 and (cl.member_id = #{memberId} or exists ( select 1 from club_member clm where clm.club_id = cl.id and clm.member_id = #{memberId} and clm.status = 1 and clm.del_flag = 0 )) )) )
mapper.update: update im_poll p join im_conversation c on c.id = p.conversation_id and c.type = 4 and c.status = 0 join im_conversation_member cm on cm.conversation_id = c.id and cm.member_id = #{memberId} and cm.deleted = 0 set p.status = 'CLOSED', p.closed_by = #{memberId}, p.closed_at = now(3), p.version = p.version + 1, p.update_time = now(3) where p.id = #{pollId} and p.creator_member_id = #{memberId} and p.status = 'OPEN' and p.version = #{expectedVersion} and ( (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'team_' and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member tm on tm.team_id = t.id and tm.member_id = #{memberId} and tm.status = 1 where c.biz_key = concat('team_', t.id) and t.status not in (3, 4) )) or (left(c.biz_key, 5) = 'club_' and exists ( select 1 from club cl where c.biz_key = concat('club_', cl.id) and cl.status = 1 and cl.del_flag = 0 and (cl.member_id = #{memberId} or exists ( select 1 from club_member clm where clm.club_id = cl.id and clm.member_id = #{memberId} and clm.status = 1 and clm.del_flag = 0 )) )) )

update im_poll set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = now(3), version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{pollId} and status = 'OPEN' and version = #{expectedVersion} and deadline_at is not null and deadline_at <= now(3)
